name: Change Proceed To Checkout Text
author: Irish_Cathal

sections.description:
Change Proceed To Checkout Text provides a simple settings screen for changing the text displayed on the WooCommerce cart checkout button.

Enter your preferred button text and save. Leave the field blank at any time to return to the standard WooCommerce text.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > Checkout Button Text.
  4. Enter your preferred checkout button text and save your changes.
